result:
The proposed answer of 2q does not match what I recall of the literature. I did not derive the correct value from scratch, so this rests on memory.

As I remember it, recent work on Thakur's 2009 conjecture shows that the F_q-linear independence of MZVs of a fixed weight holds for all weights w ≤ 2q−2, and that it fails at weight 2q−1, where an F_q-linear relation exists. That would give w_max = 2q−2.

The proposed solution's argument also has a gap. It says the first F_q-relation appears in weight 2q+1 because two products of MZVs coincide. It offers no proof that no relation exists in weights 2q−1 and 2q. Its q=2 example is not checked either. The claimed relation is in weight 5, which is above 2q−1 = 3 for q=2.

VERDICT: REJECT
